<?php
class ArrayPendingReviewPayload {
    public function __destruct() { echo "PAYLOAD;"; throw new Exception("payload-array"); }
}
$payload = new ArrayPendingReviewPayload;
$reader = new class {
    public function __get(string $incoming): array {
        global $reader, $payload;
        echo "GET;";
        $items = [$payload];
        $payload = null;
        $reader = null;
        return $items;
    }
    public function __destruct() {
        echo "RECEIVER;";
        throw new Exception("receiver-array");
    }
};
try { $reader->gone; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo $failure->getMessage(); echo ";"; echo $failure->getPrevious()->getMessage(); echo ";"; }
echo $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_RECEIVER;";
echo "DONE;";
